Brilliant!. I’ve tried many, many guitar tuner apps over the years and this is easily the best of them. No fluff, no unnecessary frills, no hidden costs, NO ADS. Just a simple tuner & metronome with all the features that most people actually need in a good tuner, presented by an elegant, simple interface that does its job beautifully. 

Unlike many tuners that have the eqivalent of a ‘centre click’ on a control knob that ‘locks on’ / goes green / snaps to centre when the tuning is ‘near enough’, with this device it is up to you the user to choose what level of accuracy is acceptable. The +/- 10 cents band in the centre is probably ‘good enough’ for many folk, but if you take a little bit of time and care, it is possible to achieve a level of accuracy that I have previously found to be elusive.

If you approach the 0 cents centre mark (always tuning up from below to the target frequency) it is possible with a little care quite easily to get within a cent or so, or with a little furthe effort get spot on ‘0’. It may be necessary to use a pick rather than just a finger, and it can sometimes help to strike the string being tuned around the 9th or 10th fret rather than over the sound hole/pick-up area, especially on the lower pitched strings (which I think may help reduce the harmonics produced ?) but whatever the reason, it makes tuning a little quicker and easier.

It’s a difficult thing to express, but I have a definite sense of my instruments being more accurately and ‘cleanly’ in tune with this tuner. Your guitar does need to be well set up and properly intonated - there is no point in trying to tune an instrument that is either untunable to begin with or which won’t hold tune once you’ve got it there - but with this tuner a decently set up guitar will sound at its best. I love it, and I am both amazed and delighted that it is free. Thank you!!
